name: Perea

identification.note: The New Testament-era name for the Transjordan territory Jesus passed through; Herod Antipas, tetrarch of Galilee and Perea, imprisoned and beheaded John the Baptist there (Matthew 14:1-12).

description: The region east of the Jordan Jesus traveled through on His final journey toward Jerusalem (Matthew 19:1; Mark 10:1).

geo.note: Approximate: the region east of the Jordan opposite Judea and Samaria.
